title: How Geralt decides Ciri's fate in The Witcher 3
subject: geralt
description:
Did your Ciri survive the ending? 👇

The hidden choices in The Witcher 3 that decide whether Ciri lives and what Geralt is left with. Spoilers for the ending of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by CD PROJEKT RED. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Ciri's fate in The Witcher 3 hinges on a snowball fight.
In the final act, the game quietly tracks how Geralt treats her.
Throw snowballs with her. Let her wreck Avallac'h's lab. Visit Skjall's grave. Let her face the sorceresses alone.
Make at least three of those choices, and Ciri returns from the White Frost.
But fall short, and she never comes back. Geralt is left holding only her medallion.
If she lives, she becomes a witcher or Empress of Nilfgaard.
His last great battle wasn't won with a sword, but with a snowball.
